networks.name: wayfinder
networks.description: Grounded Hong Kong itineraries from four browser-local agents. Default inference is deterministic rule-based planning, not an LLM.
sample_queries: Plan a 2-day food trip in Hong Kong under $150
Plan a relaxed 1-day family outing in Kowloon
Plan a 1-day culture and views trip on Hong Kong Island under $80

default.description: Deterministic offline planner; not an LLM.

byok_router.scope: goal parsing and final summary only

peer_policy.note: Agent-initiated contact is closed by default. Explicit userInitiated discovery may contact a user-supplied origin only after per-fetch consent. Peers are validated/listed only; no execution.

agent_mcp.reason: Static site: MCP discovery and execution are not implemented; unavailable capabilities fail closed.
